card.text: Explore Helene in 3D with Cassini imagery and its measured irregular shape.

introduction.text: Helene shares Dione’s orbit, traveling about 60° ahead of the larger moon. Cassini revealed a small icy world with sweeping gullies and smooth deposits across its irregular surface.

normal.title: ISS mosaic
normal.summary: Brightness matching reduces photographed shading. The gray grid marks missing coverage and terrain hidden in cast shadows.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height relative to an 18 km sphere, from the Cassini shape model. Small craters are unresolved.
